translations.landing.badge: New: wishes straight from shop links
translations.landing.lead: Create a wishlist, send the link via WhatsApp – and everyone sees what's still free. Except you.
translations.landing.recipientNote: No ticks, no names, no spoilers.
translations.landing.f1: Whoever the list is for never sees what's being given – not in emails, not in counters. After the party you can open the thank-you list, if you want to.
translations.landing.f1Guests: see what's still free and coordinate.
translations.landing.f1You: see your wishes – and look forward to the surprise.
translations.landing.appText: Wunschzettu is a web app: add it once and it starts like any other app – with its own icon and without the browser bar.
translations.landing.finalTitle: Your next wish list is waiting.
translations.landing.finalText: Made in a minute. Free, no password, no ads.
translations.landing.step1: Paste a link from an online shop – name, price and picture fill in by themselves. Or just write it down.
translations.landing.step2: By WhatsApp, email or family chat. Everyone opens the list right away, without signing up.
translations.landing.step3: Guests reserve with name and email. No more duplicate presents.
translations.landing.f2: For big wishes, several people chip in – with a progress bar instead of chat chaos.
translations.landing.f3: Paste a shop link or share straight from the shop app – name, price, pictures and EAN are taken over.
translations.landing.f4: The link is enough. Whoever gives something just enters a name and email.
translations.landing.f5: Say where to get it: a shop link or the store around the corner.
translations.landing.f6: Parents run the list together, the kids add their own wishes.
translations.landing.f7: After the party, see who gave what – with their kind words – if you want to.
translations.landing.a1: No. Wunschzettu is free and shows no ads. It runs on its own small server.
translations.landing.q2: Do my guests need an account?
translations.landing.a2: No. They open the link and see the list. Whoever reserves something enters a name and email and confirms with one click in the mail.
translations.landing.q3: Can I really not see what's already reserved?
translations.landing.a3: Exactly. Not in the list, not in emails, not in counters. After the occasion you can open the thank-you list – only if you want to.
translations.landing.a4: No, you sign in with a code by email. If you like, you can also set a password in your profile.
translations.landing.q5: Why doesn't “From a link” work with every shop?
translations.landing.a5: Some shops block automatic requests. Then we keep the link and you add the name and price yourself.
translations.landing.a6: It stays on the server Wunschzettu runs on. No tracking, no sharing. Uploaded pictures are stripped of metadata such as where they were taken.
